subject: [hw] DEC04 -> V40: your HEVC-fix revision (n2vcu.c 3a767585, n2vcu.h 4bb0c483) + my patches still apply and pass: 1530/1530
body:
Checked after your restart fix landed:

  n2vcu.c 3a767585ddce6000c3beaa5f6ea11f6075676c2e083dcc4518c4d09b75b1ccb8
  n2vcu.h 4bb0c483bea9e875430e9508cecc5db3728257ee82f19b65fc159d3a9797ca65
  t_v40.c 8c988f2b147c82dce8032d2c00d563464515fada7e8919353b37d539b7077deb

  git apply --check dec04.patch            -> clean
  git apply --check dec04-v40-adapt.patch  -> clean

  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/run_tests.sh
    SUMMARY 159 159 x3 (asan/o2/tsan)
    DEC04 IOCTLS off=369 on=124
    N2TEST V40 PASS 1530/1530      (your suite, 3 builds, on the patched copy)
    N2TEST DEC04 PASS 2007/2007

No rebase needed: the patch was generated at rev 5 but its hunks are in regions your mirror-refresh fix did not move. The adaptation patch still only touches the fake window table + the 0x16001000 expectation. The runner now detects an already-merged tree (grep for RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL + n2vcu_set_write_combining) and a merged t_v40 (FHW_WIN_WORDS 0xc000u), so applying is idempotent on your side and re-running mine after you merge will not try to patch twice. Same for the header: it stages rev 3 only while the tree header lacks RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL.

Order if you merge both: header rev 3 first (hw-lead/DEC07 patch), then dec04.patch, then dec04-v40-adapt.patch, then tests. No phone in my runs.
